result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but there are a few visual/content concerns: horizontally scrolling content is clipped at the right edge, one promo/discount label shows a meaningless “-0%”, and some truncated restaurant text reduces readability.

issues.description: Cards in the “Fastest near you” row are cut off at the right edge, and the third restaurant name is visibly truncated as “Trattoria Piccol…”.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal sections have clear scroll affordance, add edge padding/fade, or size cards so titles remain readable without abrupt clipping.

issues.description: A badge on the lower “Popular right now” card shows “-0%”, which looks like a broken or meaningless discount value.
issues.suggestion: Remove the badge when there is no discount, or replace it with a valid offer such as “€0 delivery” or an actual percentage.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped after “Healthy”, with another chip only partially visible at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side inset/gradient or adjust chip spacing so the scrollable category row looks intentional and does not appear accidentally cropped.

issues.description: The search placeholder text “Restaurants, dishes, groceries” appears relatively low contrast against the light gray field.
issues.suggestion: Increase placeholder contrast slightly while keeping it visually secondary, or ensure it meets WCAG guidance for meaningful text contrast.
